Sourced Statements: The brand announced on Wednesday, May 13, that it’s launching two new frozen products that feature Nutella layers and swirls.

Nutella Ice Cream, which comes in 14-ounce containers, offers "a rich, multi-textured, spoonable format," per a release shared with PEOPLE. It can be found in stores for a suggested price starting at $4.36.
The new ice cream is also available in 3.04-ounce single-serve wafer cones, made for "spontaneous moments on the go." A four pack has a suggested retail price starting at $5.47.
"This is the freezer-aisle debut that's been a long time coming," the brand adds.
Food Network star Alex Guarnaschelli commented on the brand's Instagram announcement with a series of clapping hands emojis.
Last month, Nutella announced that it was releasing a new flavor for the first time in its over 60 year history, Nutella Peanut. The new flavor is now available nationwide in major retailers.

"This marks the brand's first flavor innovation in its over 60 year history, delivering a new taste experience that blends the unmistakable creaminess of Nutella with the delicious taste of roasted peanuts," the brand, which began in 1964, said in an April 15 press release.
The release added that the new flavor is "perfectly spreadable" for a sandwich or other treats at "afternoon snack time."
